facts.text: I am trying to plan out my week ahead.
I want reminders for my tasks and appointments.
I aim to go to bed between 10:30 and 11 pm every night.
I have work meetings on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
My work meetings are scheduled for 2 pm.
I need to finish a project by the end of the week.
I plan to cook dinner at home on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.
I want reminders for grocery shopping and meal prep for those dinner days.
I want reminders to take breaks throughout the day.
I tend to get focused on my work and forget to take short breaks to stretch and refresh my mind.
I want reminders every hour or so to take a 5-10 minute break.
I want reminders to drink water throughout the day.
I want water reminders every hour or so to grab a glass of water and stay hydrated.
I want a reminder to review my schedule for the next day every evening around 9 pm.
I want a reminder to pack my lunch for tomorrow around 9:15 pm.
I am trying to save money by bringing my lunch to work.
I often forget to pack my lunch the night before.
